results.name: Logic unit tests (fake clock)
results.expected: all tests pass

results.name: Valid feed accepted and shown
results.expected: Reading visible via API within 5 s

results.name: Missing required field rejected
results.expected: Stored in rejects with reason missing_field:device_id

results.name: Malformed JSON flagged
results.expected: Stored in rejects with reason malformed_json

results.name: Invalid timestamp flagged
results.expected: Stored in rejects with reason invalid_timestamp

results.name: Out-of-range value flagged
results.expected: Stored in rejects with reason out_of_range:power_w

results.name: Unknown device flagged
results.expected: Stored in rejects with reason unknown_device:GHOST-99

results.name: Unknown module flagged
results.expected: Stored in rejects with reason unknown_module:cafeteria

results.name: Rejected messages never reach readings
results.expected: Latest value untouched by the 6 bad messages

results.name: Device silent > timeout becomes stale/offline + alert
results.expected: health=stale after offline_s=10 s, device_offline alert raised
results.actual: online first=True; stale after 10.8 s; alert=raised

results.name: Data resumes -> back online, offline alert clears
results.expected: health=online and alert cleared (<=10 s timer)

results.name: Alert correct: severity/value, de-dup, ack, clear
results.expected: 1 row (2 identical events), active -> acknowledged -> cleared
results.actual: rows=1, first=active, ack http=200, after ack=acknowledged, after clear=cleared

results.name: Units and last-updated time shown
results.expected: metric has unit + received time; page renders 'x s ago' and SIMULATED label

results.name: Role check on acknowledge
results.expected: viewer 403, operator 200

results.name: CSV export (administrator only, filtered)
results.expected: operator 403; admin 200, header + data rows, only energy
results.actual: operator 403, admin 200, 28 lines, header ok=True, all energy=True

results.name: Filters by module / building / zone
results.expected: only matching devices returned

results.name: Filter input is not injectable
results.expected: treated as 'no filter', no error, 9 registered devices

results.name: Normal: occupied + dark -> light ON, fan OFF
results.expected: occupied, daylight keeps light OFF; darkness turns light ON
results.actual: bright: occ=True light=False; dark -> light ON after 0.9 s; fan=False

results.name: Threshold: 31.5 C occupied -> fan ON + alert
results.expected: fan ON, high_temperature alert active

results.name: Boundary: hysteresis at 30.0 / 30.1 / 27.0 / 26.9 C
results.expected: fan flips only above 30 C and below 27 C

results.name: Sensor disconnect: 3 bad reads -> fail-safe
results.expected: fan forced OFF, sensor_fault true, sensor_failure alert

results.name: Recovery: sensor returns -> alert clears, logic resumes
results.expected: sensor_fault false, alert cleared

results.name: Vacancy: no motion 30 s -> light OFF (stationary occupant limitation)
results.expected: still occupied at +20 s; vacant and light OFF by ~30 s
results.actual: at +20 s occupied=True; vacant+light OFF after a further 10.4 s

results.name: False trigger: single PIR pulse ignored
results.expected: room stays vacant, light stays OFF

results.name: Device killed (last will) then restarted: resumes
results.expected: offline + alert after kill; online again and alert cleared after restart
results.actual: offline=True, alert=raised, back online after 0.4 s, alert cleared after 9.7 s

results.name: Broker outage: stop/start Mosquitto, all parties reconnect
results.expected: Node-RED + device resume without restart
results.actual: NOT RUN: needs admin to stop the Mosquitto service; do it by hand (docs/phase8_validation.md)
